name: Hakkar the Soulflayer
shortDescription: The blood god physically summoned into Azeroth at Zul'Gurub during WoW Classic.
body: Original interpretive depiction of Hakkar's later physical manifestation: a crimson serpent body, blue feathered crest and wings, and restrained bronze ornament. Keep this figure distinct from the skeletal teal avatar summoned in the Sunken Temple. Visual details are interpretive, not a canonical model capture.
